fields.name: client
fields.label: Client
fields.instructions: Select one documented client, or leave empty. Logo permission does not approve project photography.

fields.name: client_name
fields.label: Confirmed Client Name (if no record)
fields.instructions: Optional verified name only; ignored when a Client record is selected.

fields.name: short_summary
fields.label: Short Summary
fields.instructions: Use verified facts. Do not invent dates, results or scope.

fields.name: project_year
fields.label: Verified Project Year
fields.instructions: Leave empty when unknown.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.label: Sort Order
fields.instructions: Lower numbers appear first. This is the only ordering value.

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.instructions: Select all relevant individual services; these taxonomy assignments are the source of truth.

fields.name: listing_thumbnail
fields.label: Listing Thumbnail
fields.instructions: Required to publish a Video Project. Used on the Work portfolio grid and as the video poster when no separate approved Video Poster Image is selected. Recommended landscape crop.

fields.name: listing_fit
fields.label: Listing Image Fit
fields.instructions: Contain preserves full website screenshots.

fields.name: project_media_type
fields.label: Project Media Type
fields.instructions: Choose whether this Project uses an image or short video as its main media.

fields.name: project_video
fields.label: Project Video
fields.instructions: Upload a web-ready MP4: H.264, 1080p or smaller, 10 seconds or less. Aim below 20–30 MB; your server upload limit still applies. Approve the video in Media Library before publishing. Essential speech needs captions; this player is intended for visual clips without essential dialogue.

fields.name: project_video_poster
fields.label: Video Poster Image
fields.instructions: Optional. Choose approved artwork only if you want a different image before the video starts or when motion is reduced. Otherwise the approved Listing Thumbnail is used; an approved Hero Image is the next fallback.

fields.name: hero_media
fields.label: Hero Media
fields.instructions: Main project image; native proportions are preserved.

fields.name: project_image_1
fields.label: Additional Image 1
fields.instructions: Optional. Images display in numbered order; leave unused slots empty.

fields.name: project_image_2
fields.label: Additional Image 2
fields.instructions: Optional. Images display in numbered order; leave unused slots empty.

fields.name: project_image_3
fields.label: Additional Image 3
fields.instructions: Optional. Images display in numbered order; leave unused slots empty.

fields.name: project_image_4
fields.label: Additional Image 4
fields.instructions: Optional. Images display in numbered order; leave unused slots empty.

fields.name: project_image_5
fields.label: Additional Image 5
fields.instructions: Optional. Images display in numbered order; leave unused slots empty.

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Featured
fields.instructions: Publication uses the normal WordPress Draft / Published status.

fields.name: media_status
fields.label: Media Status
fields.instructions: Only Approved media may be displayed publicly. Restricted files must stay outside public uploads.

fields.name: internal_media_note
fields.label: Internal Media Note
fields.instructions: Internal only. Never displayed on the website.
